01 / Products in the real world

Less chasing.
More moving forward.

Two products built around the moments where work usually gets stuck.

01Operations / SaaS

Onboard Hub

An onboarding management system connecting bookings, migrations, exports, and operational handoffs. So the next step doesn’t get lost between teams.

  • Bookings
  • Migrations
  • Team handoffs
Open product ↗Repository ↗
Inside the product

The problem: A booking is only the beginning. Migrations, exports and handoffs can leave teams working from different versions of the same story.

The approach: Connect the workflow and make the next action easier to follow.

02Pre-sales / SaaS

Demo Hub

A pre-sales booking tool with lead capture, scheduling, rescheduling, and a team dashboard. Less back-and-forth between interest and a real conversation.

  • Lead capture
  • Scheduling
  • Team dashboard
Open product ↗Repository ↗
Inside the product

The problem: Promising leads lose momentum in the back-and-forth of booking and coordinating with sales.

The approach: Bring lead capture, scheduling and the team’s view into one flow.

From my resume: 1,500 demos booked and 200 converted to paid customers.

03 / AI that moves the work along

A conversation.
Then, a next step.

Agents that understand the context and help people move forward.

Booking Agent

Discovery → Visit

Qualifies what someone needs, recommends relevant properties, and guides them toward a visit — across the channels they already use.

I need a place near my office.

BOOKING AGENTWhich area, and what budget feels right?

Sector 62. Around ₹15,000 a month.

Understand intent→Recommend→Plan a visit

Support Agent

Issue → Action

Captures complaints in a WhatsApp-style conversation, gathers the context, and routes the next step so the issue can reach the right team.

The tap in my room is leaking.

SUPPORT AGENTLet’s get the details. Which room are you in?

Room 204. It started this morning.

I’m Aditya, a product operator and former founder working across AI, SaaS, and PropTech. I like turning messy workflows into clear products — and staying involved from the first idea to the everyday details.

Outside work, there’s usually a badminton match, an AI weekend experiment, a PS5 session, or another idea for my room’s interiors. Making things better seems to follow me home.
